description: Baseline metric thresholds for the full 237-case eval (propose/confirm booking architecture; typed search_rooms tool, returning 4 rooms by default and up to 15 on request via its limit argument; split routing, so one message can reach both agents), including the fifteen attribute-search cases case_0207 to case_0221 and the twelve split-routing cases case_0226 to case_0237. Set from the mean of three runs, since single-run variance on the judge-scored metrics is large. strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite; booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium and the router's is none. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference). Ragas skips split turns, whose reply and contexts also carry the room search. Ragas calls retry transient Gemini errors, and a failed call is never scored as 0.0. Route accuracy ignores the order of a split turn's steps. The search_rooms room_types, bed_types, and view_types descriptions say to list every value that is a kind of what the guest asked for, and the labels expect the inclusive reading of 'suites' and 'ocean view'; case_0220's second turn accepts every combination. propose_booking and propose_modification refuse dates outside the availability window with a message that names the window and says to retry with another year if the guest gave none. booking_no_unexpected_failure_rate was 1.0 in all three runs. booking_tool_errors is 0.998 because case_0121's first proposal in one run used 2026, was refused with that message, and was retried with 2025. booking_expected_search_pass_rate is 0.9885 because case_0216 searched view_types ['Ocean View'] alone in one run; min_allowed 0.85 allows about four missed cases out of 29. route_accuracy is 0.9984 from one misroute in each run (case_0153, case_0057, case_0005), and the latter two also cost info_reference_subset_pass_rate. info_expected_filters_pass_rate is 0.9963 because case_0005's 'I only have 20-minute' turn was again read as an exact duration in two runs. judge_consumer_quality misses were single 4.0 scores on case_0153, case_0187, case_0017, and case_0006. booking_no_unbacked_success_claims stays at 1.0; the evaluator accepts a confirm made on the same turn or any earlier turn as backing for a success claim. Thresholds were left unchanged from the 221-case baseline.
